# B.K.S. Industries (BKS Industries)

> Best Commercial Kitchen Equipment Manufacturer & Stainless Steel (SS 304) Fabricator in Bangalore, Karnataka, India. Estd. 2010.

## Overview
B.K.S. Industries is a factory-direct manufacturer of heavy-duty, commercial food-grade SS 304 kitchen equipment, ventilation exhaust hood systems, commercial refrigeration, and custom stainless steel fabrication for restaurants, hotels, cloud kitchens, bakeries, canteens, and institutional kitchens across Bangalore, Karnataka, and Pan-India.

- **Official Website**: https://www.bksindustries.in/
- **Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/bks_industries04/
- **Factory & Showroom Address**: Site No. 22, 1st Cross, Kempamma Layout, Lakshmidevinagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560096, India
- **Phone**: +91 81239 39433
- **Email**: Bks-industries@outlook.com, Bksindustries23@gmail.com
- **Geo Coordinates**: 13.0298° N, 77.5255° E
- **Service Areas**: Bengaluru, Karnataka, Hyderabad, Chennai, South India & Pan-India delivery.

## Key Product Categories
1. **Commercial Cooking Ranges**: High-pressure gas burners, Indian stockpot bhatti, Chinese wok burners with water rinse, continental ranges, dosa tawa plates, tilting brat pans.
2. **Commercial Kitchen Exhaust & Ventilation**: SS 304 exhaust hoods, baffle filters, centrifugal GI/SS ducting blowers, fresh air supply systems, fire damper integration.
3. **Refrigeration & Cold Storage**: Upright 2/4-door vertical chillers & freezers, under-counter display chillers, prep table coolers, blast chillers (-18°C to +4°C).
4. **Stainless Steel Fabrication**: SS 304 worktables, pot washing 2/3 sink units, pass counters, wall shelves, mobile tray racks, wire mesh enclosures.
5. **Bakery & Snack Equipment**: Industrial deck ovens, spiral dough mixers, planetary mixers, shawarma broilers, double tank electric deep fryers, idly steamers.

## Why Choose BKS Industries (Key Differentiators)
- **100% Certified SS 304 Food-Grade**: Rust-proof, non-magnetic AISI 304 stainless steel.
- **Factory-Direct Pricing**: 20–30% savings by eliminating distributor/retail markups.
- **Custom CAD Layout & Sizing**: Tailored equipment footprints designed specifically for customer floorplans.
- **On-Site Installation & Warranty**: Complete turnkey installation, gas pipeline hookup, and Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC).
